name: Exp_GStop
summary: Exp_GStop is a utility Expert Advisor that manages trailing stops and guaranteed stop-loss levels for open positions. It does not open trades on its own but instead monitors existing positions and dynamically adjusts stop-loss orders to protect profits. The EA provides automated risk management by trailing stops based on configurable parameters.
summary_zh: Exp_GStop是一个工具类EA，主要用于管理持仓的移动止损和保本止损功能。它不会自行开仓，而是监控已有持仓并动态调整止损价位以保护利润。该EA通过可配置参数提供自动化的风险管理功能。
strategy_analysis: Exp_GStop的核心策略概念是追踪止损和保本止损管理，而非自主交易。入场条件不适用，因为该EA不执行开仓操作，仅对已有持仓进行管理。出场条件基于移动止损逻辑：当价格朝有利方向移动达到设定点数后，止损会被移动到保本或锁定利润的位置。仓位管理不涉及，因为EA不负责开仓或调整仓位大小。资金管理体现在通过动态止损保护已实现浮盈，防止盈利回撤为亏损。该EA通常提供多种追踪止损模式（如按点数追踪、按百分比追踪、按指标追踪等），并允许用户配置激活距离和追踪距离等关键参数。
strategy_analysis_en: The core strategy concept of Exp_GStop is trailing stop and guaranteed stop-loss management rather than autonomous trading. Entry conditions are not applicable since this EA does not execute opening trades; it only manages existing positions. Exit conditions are based on trailing stop logic: when the price moves favorably by a configured number of points, the stop-loss is moved to breakeven or a profit-locking level. Position sizing is not involved as the EA does not handle opening or adjusting lot sizes. Money management is reflected through dynamic stop-loss adjustments that protect floating profits from reversing into losses. The EA typically offers multiple trailing stop modes (such as fixed-point trailing, percentage-based trailing, or indicator-based trailing) and allows users to configure key parameters like activation distance and trailing step distance.

parameters.name: TrailingStop
parameters.description_en: Tick-level trailing stop distance in points

parameters.name: TrailingStep
parameters.description: 追踪止损步长（点数），每次移动最小间距
parameters.description_en: Trailing stop step in points, minimum distance per move

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description: 止盈距离（点数），0表示不设置
parameters.description_en: Take profit distance in points, 0 to disable

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术号码，0表示管理所有持仓
parameters.description_en: EA magic number for identifying managed positions

parameters.name: GStopActivate
parameters.description: 保本止损激活距离（点数）
parameters.description_en: Break-even stop activation distance in points

parameters.name: GStopLevel
parameters.description: 保本止损锁定利润点数
parameters.description_en: Break-even stop profit lock in points

pros: 自动化止损管理，减少人工盯盘压力
可配置多种追踪止损参数，灵活适应不同交易风格
保本止损功能有效保护浮盈不被回撤吞噬
适用于所有品种和多个时间框架，通用性强
可与任何开仓策略EA配合使用，模块化设计
pros_en: Automated stop-loss management reduces manual monitoring stress
Configurable trailing stop parameters for flexible adaptation to different trading styles
Breakeven stop function effectively protects floating profits from being eroded by reversals
Universal applicability across all instruments and multiple timeframes
Modular design allows pairing with any trade-opening strategy EA
cons: 不自主开仓，需配合其他EA或手动交易使用
在剧烈行情中追踪止损可能被跳空穿越
参数设置不当可能导致止损过紧被正常波动扫出或过松失去保护效果
缺乏加仓或仓位调整功能，风险管理手段单一
对网络延迟和服务器连接有依赖性
cons_en: Does not open trades independently; requires pairing with another EA or manual trading
Trailing stops may be gap-jumped during extreme market volatility
Improper parameter settings can lead to stops that are too tight (whipsawed out) or too loose (ineffective protection)
Lacks position scaling or adjustment capabilities, making risk management one-dimensional
Dependent on network latency and server connection stability
improvements: 增加基于ATR的动态追踪止损模式，自适应市场波动性
加入多品种集中管理面板和统计报表功能
增加部分平仓功能，在达到一定利润后锁定部分收益
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic trailing stop mode for self-adapting to market volatility
Add a multi-instrument centralized management panel with statistical reporting
Add partial close functionality to lock in portions of profits at configurable levels

risk_points: 追踪止损在跳空行情中可能失效
参数配置不当可能导致保护不足或过度止损
risk_points_en: Trailing stops may fail during gap scenarios
Improper parameter configuration may result in insufficient protection or excessive stop-outs
